epoch_result.timing_policy: One cold train epoch with fresh AdamW and initially empty geometry caches, then validation using the naturally populated cache. Includes disk loading, collation, transfers, complete A/B/H forward/backward, real updates, full diagnostics and metric aggregation. Setup/hashing reported separately. No repeated fixed-case hot-cache extrapolation.
epoch_result.os_file_cache_policy: OS file caches are not cleared; provenance hashing before timing can warm measurement files. Cold refers to model geometry/kernel caches and fresh optimizer, not forced cold storage.
epoch_result.extrapolation_limitation: A linear projection from one shared-GPU epoch with fresh weights/optimizer; not an exclusive-GPU result, confidence interval, convergence budget or observed 300-epoch run. Includes train/validation runner metrics, excludes setup and research checkpoint/freeze serialization; future sampling, cache misses and load can change throughput.
